A letter for Negin

I hid something special inside this little envelope — open it and then tap the tabs to see both sides.

Dear Negin,

Happy birthday to one of my closest friends. It’s kind of funny how we only met about a year ago in class, because from that very first moment I had a feeling we would become friends — and I’m really happy that feeling was right.

In this one year, you’ve become such an important part of my life. Thank you for your kindness, your energy, your calm, and for being the kind of person who makes everything feel warmer and easier. Every conversation, every laugh, and every little moment with you means a lot to me.

I hope this new year of your life brings you so much happiness, success, peace, good surprises, sweet moments, lots of chai, and all the chocolate your heart wants. You deserve beautiful days and beautiful memories.

With love, Kamyab ✨
